name: Hanzan (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Hanzan town emblem in white: a ring with a hooked top enclosing a stylised mountain.
history: Flag of the former town of Hanzan in Kagawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-22. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1966.

features.role: Hanzan town emblem — a ring with a hooked top enclosing a stylised mountain
